descriptions.test_api_health_returns_200_with_standar: Verifies GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 and JSON with success=true, a message, and data.status equal to ok per the standard success_response helper.
descriptions.test_task_one_layered_structure_present: Verifies Task 1 folder layout: routes, services, repositories, models, and config packages with __init__.py, plus utils/response.py and wired health route/service modules.

error_messages.test_api_health_returns_200_with_standar: Health endpoint must return 200 with the standard success JSON envelope (success, message, data.status ok).
error_messages.test_task_one_layered_structure_present: Layered monolith folders and health wiring files from Task 1 must exist under exskilence_project.

tests.name: Health API visible in browser
tests.description: Loads /api/health and confirms the page URL and document body render (JSON health check for Task 1).

tests.name: Unknown API path returns error JSON body
tests.description: Navigates to a non-existent /api route and confirms the browser shows a body (standard JSON error envelope from global 404 handler).

assertions.error_message: Expected to remain on the unknown API path
Error JSON response body should be visible
Document body must exist for 404 JSON
